nodes.name: No mealId, attendance prerequisite or seven-day window. again is Yes/No/null with no default; one answer OR one reason permits Save. Clear again retains reasons. Cancelling restores the latest confirmed version; first blank cancellation writes nothing. This storyboard demonstrates reason-only→saved→return/reopen→Yes update→clear again while preserving the reason. Other seven-value combinations and No use the same native chip component and PM rules; arbitrary input is not simulated.
